shabad.source_english: Codes of Conduct and Other Panthic Sources

en.bdb: Khalsa is the one, who renounces slander,
Khalsa is the one who volunteers to contend in the first rank.(44)

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਾਲਸਾ ਸੋਇ ਜੋ ਪੰਚ ਕੋ ਮਾਰੈ
verses.translit_en: khaalasaa soi jo pa(n)ch ko maarai

en.bdb: Khalsa is the one who annuls the five vices.
Khalsa is the one who burns the (effect of) the (previous) actions.(45)
Khalsa is the one who relinquishes the ego.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਾਲਸਾ ਸੋਇ ਜੋ ਪਰਤ੍ਰੀਆ ਤੇ ਭਾਗੈ। (੪੬)
verses.translit_en: khaalasaa soi jo paratreeaa te bhaagai| (46)

en.bdb: Khalsa is the one who keeps away from another's wife.(46)
Khalsa is the one who does not imitate the others' viewpoint.
Khalsa is the one who is infused with the divine name.(47)

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਾਲਸਾ ਸੋਇ ਗੁਰ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਿਤ ਲਾਇ
verses.translit_en: khaalasaa soi gur baanee hit lai

en.bdb: Khalsa is the one who puts his heart into Gurbani.
Khalsa is the one who can eat the steel.(48)
